findings.detail: F25 observed a 0.5334 growth spread, but source total investments fell from 376,992,972 to 325,772,154 while total assets fell from 387,246,061 to 349,209,446, implying only a 0.037643 spread.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate anchor check. The raw filing total-assets row shows 349,209,446 at June 30, 2024 and 387,246,061 at December 31, 2023, a -0.098223 growth rate. The Schedule of Investments total fair value rows show 325,772,154 at June 30, 2024 and 376,992,972 at December 31, 2023, a -0.135867 growth rate. The absolute spread is 0.037643, well below the F25 0.30 tolerance, so the flagged observed metric 0.5334 is inconsistent with the filing anchors.
